recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No follow-up is recommended for FHIR-13336 unless a future work-group decision separately changes or retires the GraphQL List-navigation guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-13336 requested an operation or set of operations to retrieve subsets of a List by paging and filtering. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution chose the more general GraphQL approach instead of a List-specific lightweight syntax and said to add examples for the use case.
initial_application: The application maps to git-svn commit f826c295e1c06913248e943675d20ab57f14af69, message 'GF#13336 - escribe use of graphQL for filtering lists', with SVN revision 13141 matching the Jira comment. That commit added the GraphQL List-navigation section and List notes link; same-day commit c10c1902774f1eef6ff8a0efaad7079010bf6616 added the long List example used by the GraphQL URL.
additional_context: List is active in source/fhir.ini, source/list/list-notes.xml links the large-List efficiency guidance to graphql.html#list, and source/graphql.html still documents FHIRPath/field filtering plus _offset and _count with a List/long example. Later incubator operations for large resources are listed alongside GraphQL and do not supersede the applied GraphQL guidance. Community searches found no substantive conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the build-scoped current source already contains the GraphQL paging/filtering examples and List page linkage required by the final Jira disposition.
